description: When \(\psi(\bar a,y)\) has no satisfying witness in the ambient structure, its selected witness is the designated fallback element \(m_*\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ElementarySubmodels.selectedWitness_fallback.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] (m : M) {n : ℕ} (φ : L.BoundedFormula Empty (n + 1)) (a : Fin n → M)
  (h : ¬∃ b, φ.Realize default (Fin.snoc a b)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ElementarySubmodels.selectedWitness m φ a = m
